title: Jevolution: A Framework for Studying Communication and Collective Dynamics in AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.14449v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Experiments with remote decision-making agents depend on more than the policy: the world may change during inference, the simulator determines which actions are available, and births and immigration alter who can act. We present Jevolution, an instrumented spatial predator-prey framework that makes these dependencies explicit. Its reference implementation separates the evolving world, asynchronous request scheduling, controller adapters, and experiment records. The model combines local observations, energy and resource constraints, predefined signals, and inherited scalar traits. We describe these mechanisms using the ODD protocol and distinguish implemented controls from research questions requiring additional interventions. Free synthetic fixtures exercise scheduling, signaling, and inheritance against the pinned implementation; they validate specified software behavior rather than model intelligence or ecological realism. translated_title: Jevolution：一个用于研究AI智能体通信与集体动力学的框架
translated_abstract: 使用远程决策智能体的实验不仅取决于策略本身：世界可能在推理过程中发生变化，模拟器决定了哪些动作可用，而出生和迁入会改变哪些主体能够行动。我们提出了Jevolution，这是一个经过插桩的空间捕食者-猎物框架，使这些依赖关系变得明确。其参考实现将演化中的世界、异步请求调度、控制器适配器和实验记录分离开来。该模型结合了局部观测、能量与资源约束、预定义信号以及可遗传的标量性状。我们使用ODD协议描述这些机制，并区分已实现的控制手段与需要额外干预的研究问题。免费的合成测试夹具针对固定版本的实现来测试调度、信号传递和继承机制；它们验证的是指定的软件行为，而非模型的智能水平或生态真实性。一个完整的
tldr: Jevolution是一个模块化的空间捕食者-猎物仿真框架，通过分离演化世界、异步调度、控制器适配与实验记录等组件，为研究AI智能体的通信与集体动力学提供了透明可控的实验平台。
en_tdlr: Jevolution is an instrumented spatial predator-prey framework that decouples the evolving world, asynchronous scheduling, controller adapters, and experiment records, providing a transparent and controllable platform for studying communication and collective dynamics in AI agents.
